gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all notification schemes to understand how notifications are configured across different projects.
gold.ideal: A successful response containing a list of all notification schemes with their details.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new notification scheme to customize how users are notified about issues.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating that the notification scheme has been created, along with its ID.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to see which notification schemes are mapped to specific projects to ensure proper notifications are sent.
gold.ideal: A successful response containing a mapping of projects to their respective notification schemes.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to view the details of a specific notification scheme to verify its settings.
gold.ideal: A successful response with the details of the specified notification scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to update an existing notification scheme to modify the notification settings for my team.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the notification scheme has been updated.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to add new notification types to an existing scheme to enhance communication.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating that the notifications have been added to the scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete an outdated notification scheme to keep the system clean and organized.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the notification scheme has been deleted.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to remove a specific notification from a scheme to reduce unnecessary alerts for my team.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the notification has been removed from the scheme.
